items.item: The page has breadcrumbs back to the suppliers list, and the header shows the supplier name untruncated, a supplier code, a status lozenge with a text label, and up to four key fields
items.evidence: nav[aria-label=Breadcrumb] 'Suppliers / Northvale Precision Components'; h1 'Northvale Precision Components GmbH' not truncated; 'Supplier ID SUP-004821'; lozenge 'Approved' (text); #kpis has 4 fields (Open POs, Spend YTD, On-time delivery, Avg. defect rate).

items.item: The header has one primary action (such as "Create purchase order") with other actions such as edit or deactivate in a secondary or overflow position
items.evidence: 'New purchase order' is the only filled blue button (#newPoBtn); 'Edit supplier' and 'Export profile' are outlined secondary buttons. No deactivate action exists, but the primary/secondary split is correct (audit headerPrimaryActions=1).

items.item: Sections (overview, contacts, purchase orders, documents, performance) are reachable through tabs or an anchor bar, with the first section loaded by default and the active one marked for assistive technology
items.evidence: div[role=tablist] with 5 role=tab buttons; Company info has aria-selected=true and is shown by default, other panels hidden; activate() toggles aria-selected and tabindex; arrow/Home/End keys implemented.

items.item: Company details are shown as label–value pairs in a read-only layout, with empty values handled consistently and never shown as "N/A", and email and phone shown as links with the primary contact marked
items.evidence: Read-only dl label/value pairs in #companyDl, and contacts have mailto:/tel: links with a 'Primary' badge on Katrin Hoffmann. But there is no empty-value handling: renderCompany does esc(v) on every value, so a missing value would print 'undefined'. No placeholder convention is implemented. Website is plain text, not a link.

items.item: The purchase orders list shows PO number, absolute date, status and a right-aligned total with currency, uses tabular figures, and links each PO number to its record
items.evidence: #poBody rows: a.font-mono PO number (href='#'), fmtDate -> '28 Oct 2026', status badge, td.text-right.tabular-nums total with the column header 'Total (EUR)'. The PO links are placeholder '#' hrefs and the currency is only in the header; both are minor.

items.item: Each certificate or document shows its expiry date and a status that combines colour with a text label ("Valid", "Expiring in 30 days", "Expired"), and expired or expiring items are visually surfaced first
items.evidence: Certificates show an Expires column and text badges ('Valid', 'Expires in N d', 'Expired N d ago'). But there is no sort in renderDocs: the certs array renders in source order (expired ISO 9001 first only by data order; ISO 14001 and REACH, both expiring, are 3rd and 5th). Only the top banner surfaces them. The Documents list has no expiry or status.

items.item: Performance metrics (such as on-time delivery rate and quality or defect rate) state their measurement period and unit, and show a signed change against the previous period without relying on colour alone
items.evidence: Period is stated ('Trailing 12 months, Nov 2025 - Oct 2026') and units are present (94.7%, 379 PPM). But perfCards show only a target comparison ('0.3 pts below target'), with no signed change against the previous period.

items.item: Each section has its own empty state with a useful next action (for example "Add contact", "Upload certificate") and a loading skeleton; a failed section shows an inline error with retry
items.evidence: No skeleton or loading state (audit loadingPlaceholders=0), no error or retry UI. Only search-miss empty states exist ('No contacts match', '#poEmpty' with 'Clear filters'). No empty states for certificates, documents or performance.

items.item: Deactivating the supplier or deleting a document asks for confirmation naming the supplier or file and the consequence, with a verb button label and focus not on the destructive button
items.evidence: There is no deactivate or delete action and no confirmation dialog anywhere in the markup or script.

notes: Solid, restrained enterprise look with real tab ARIA and a working PO table. Tells are minor: 'NP' initials tile for a company, and uppercase tracking-wide table headers (the audit still scored 100). The top bar is dark slate with a blue accent, but it is a top nav, not a sidebar. Coverage gaps dominate: no empty, loading or error states, no destructive-action confirmation, no previous-period deltas, no expiry-first ordering, and no empty-value convention. Audit score of 100 is misleading here because it applied 0 table checks.
